statement: AMD's AI accelerator revenue carries a gross margin slightly below the corporate average while server CPU revenue is accretive; non-GAAP gross margin was 56% in Q2 2026 with roughly 56% guided for Q3 2026.
why: It shows the AI ramp is margin-dilutive at the percentage level even as it adds gross profit dollars — the trade-off that decides whether volume growth is worth it.

impact.mechanism: A larger AI accelerator mix dilutes percentage gross margin while adding absolute gross profit, so a steeper Helios ramp pressures reported margin.

evidence.excerpt: Server business... is accretive to our overall gross margin. Data center AI ramp... adds revenue but also gross profit, even though the gross margin is slightly below corporate average.
non-GAAP gross margin of approximately 56% for Q3 2026. Reported Q2 2026 non-GAAP gross margin was 56% (GAAP 54%).

evidence.source: AMD Investor Relations (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.)
evidence.excerpt: Non-GAAP: gross margin 56%; operating income $3.094 billion; net income $2.760 billion; diluted EPS $1.66.

evidence.source: AMD Investor Relations (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.)
evidence.excerpt: "Non-GAAP gross margin is expected to be approximately 56%."

confidence.basis: Secondary transcript; the 56% figures trace to AMD's own press release but are relayed here rather than filed.
